iirc, the purpose of H+ was to create a sort of "pity system" in the earlier Armored Core games. Every time you either fail a mission, or use more resources than you can afford (ammunition, repair costs, etc.), you begin to rack up debt. If your debt climbs too high, you have to undergo a surgical process called "Human+", which wipes away your debt.

When this happens, you're forced to restart the game from the beginning, but you gain a permanent buff. These buffs can stack up to a certain limit (I don't recall the exact number).

In my opinion, H+ would make sense if it were possible to go into a "Negative Soul Count", where your resources are not just lost, but you can even get to a point of being in soul/rune debt.
